title: 第1974章 玄武护道皈依佛门第1973章 菩萨招揽黄雀在后
slug: 家族修仙我以子嗣登仙
content_zh:
没人清楚玄武神君下场的缘由。
可它既然在这，那么一切的结果就不再是解烦神君与【梵妙潮音菩萨】能单独决定的。
【梵妙潮音菩萨】先前就没有插手。
如今对上玄武神君，她就更没有得罪人的必要了。
倒是解烦神君有点下不来台。
他本人全权负责这次夺取神位的行动。
在此之前，【天庭】已经搭进去了相当的人力物力，这要是折戟而归了，对他个人的履历会有不小的影响。
解烦神君自然是不甘心的。
他如今仍然存了一丝侥幸的心理。
自己是打不过玄武神君。
但是，他背后的【天庭】足以踏平整个玄武族群。
只要玄武神君还顾及这点，那他就有可能对自己服软。
解烦神君于是打出了这张威胁的牌。
然而，玄武神君根本不给他半点面子。
他的神体直接朝前倾压，解烦神君刺出的每一戟都像是砸在了铁板上，根本无法对玄武神君造成任何实质性的伤害。
玄武神君都没有主动出手，胜负就见了分晓。
这对解烦神君而言，无疑是莫大的羞辱。
他没法报复玄武神君，只能狠狠地看向陈景安，此刻后者已经着手【清浊分离】的证道流程了。
陈景安已经隔绝了外界的感知。
他的身躯显化于“清气”与“浊气”之间。

这正好对应的就是上身和下身。
此时此刻，界河已经与陈景安深度绑定在了一起。
他的一举一动，都会深刻影响到界河。
这让陈青玄生出了一种熟悉感。
他觉得此刻的陈景安，有点像是天道。
不过，木已成舟。
有着玄武神君的护持，便是解烦神君想要阻止也无可奈何。
解烦神君自己同样清楚这点。
因此，他早在陈景安身影虚化的那一刻，就已经下令天庭的人撤退了。
陈青玄则转头去看【梵妙潮音菩萨】。
这样的结果，要怎么算？
她还准备将陈景安纳入佛门么。
【梵妙潮音菩萨】只是瞪了他一眼，没再吭声。
她不得不承认自己小瞧了陈景安。
他竟然能在下界搭上“玄武神君”的人脉，合该他今日突破成功。
content_en:
No one knows why Xuanwu Shenjun met his end.
But since it is here, all the results can no longer be determined by the Lord Jiefan and [Brahma Miao Chaoyin Bodhisattva] alone.
[Fanmiao Chaoyin Bodhisattva] had not intervened before.
Now that she was facing the Xuanwu God Lord, there was no need for her to offend anyone.
On the contrary, Lord Jiefan Shenjun was a bit unable to get off the stage.
He himself was solely responsible for this operation to seize the throne of God.
Prior to this, [Heavenly Court] had invested considerable manpower and material resources. If this failed, it would have a considerable impact on his personal resume.
The God of Jiefan was naturally unwilling to do so.
He still has a sense of luck.
He can't defeat the Xuanwu God Lord.
However, the [Heavenly Court] behind him is enough to flatten the entire Xuanwu clan.
As long as Xuanwu God Lord still takes this into consideration, then he may be soft on himself.
The God of Jiefan then played this threatening card.
However, Lord Xuanwu didn't give him any face at all.
His divine body leaned forward directly, and every halberd thrust out by Lord Jiefan seemed to hit an iron plate, unable to cause any substantial damage to Lord Xuanwu.
The Xuanwu God Lord didn't take the initiative to take action, and the outcome was already decided.
This is undoubtedly a great humiliation for the God of Jiefan.
He could not retaliate against the Xuanwu God Lord, so he could only look at Chen Jingan fiercely. At this moment, the latter had already started the process of enlightenment of "Separation of Purity and Turbidity".
Chen Jingan has cut off the perception of the outside world.
His body manifests between "clear air" and "turbid air".
This corresponds exactly to the upper body and lower body.
At this moment, Jiehe and Chen Jingan were deeply bound together.
Every move he makes will have a profound impact on Jiehe.
This gave Chen Qingxuan a sense of familiarity.
He felt that Chen Jingan at this moment was a bit like the way of heaven.
However, the done thing is done.
With the protection of the Xuanwu God, even if the Jiefan God wants to stop it, there is nothing he can do.
The God of Jiefan himself also knows this.
Therefore, he had already ordered the people in Heaven to retreat as early as the moment Chen Jing'an's figure disappeared.
Chen Qingxuan turned to look at [Brahma Miao Chao Yin Bodhisattva].
How to calculate such a result?
Is she still planning to incorporate Chen Jing'an into Buddhism?
[Fanmiao Chaoyin Bodhisattva] just glared at him and said nothing.
She had to admit that she underestimated Chen Jing'an.
He was actually able to make connections with the "Xuanwu God Lord" in the lower realm, so it is fitting that he succeeded in making a breakthrough today.
